source.title: Epoch of Fusion Seed — LV35 Buildings & 4th Battle Queue

claims_extracted.claim: Starting from Week 27 after server launch, once Combat Craft Modification technology reaches 60%, the Epoch of Fusion Seed technology tree becomes available at the Research Center.
Completing the final Epoch of Fusion Seed technology increases the Energy Core level cap to 35.
Energy Core Level 33 unlocks a fourth Battle Queue.
Fusion Seed is used for Epoch of Fusion Seed research and Lvl 31–35 building upgrades, including Energy Core.
Fusion Seed sources listed by the official article are Fusion Seed Refinery, Trader Commissions, Ruins Excavation and related packs.
Fusion Seed Refinery starts with 1 Fusion Reactor; related technology adds 2 reactors and Refinery upgrades add 3 reactors, for a maximum of 6 reactors.
From Energy Core Level 31 through 35, each Energy Core level raises Champion level cap by 5 and Flagship level cap by 1.
Lvl 31–35 building upgrades use 5 Energy Slots per level; each completed stage fills one slot and consumes Fusion Seeds.
At 80% Combat Craft Modification technology progress, Kinetic, Beam and Ion specialization trees unlock.
